report.one: İlkokul öğretmenlerinin ders platformu ve ders kitabı yayıncısı. Hendek dar; son 12 ay kârının beşte biri finansal varlık değerleme kazancı, büyüme ders kitabı döngüsüne bağlı.
report.business: i-Scream Media, Kore'de ilkokul öğretmenlerinin derste kullandığı dijital içerik platformu i-Scream S'i işletir ve 2022'den beri ilkokul ders kitabı yayımlar. Okullara ders araç gereci satan bir internet mağazası (i-Scream Mall) ve öğretmen eğitimi de vardır. 2025'te hasılat 195,9 milyar won, esas faaliyet kârı 61,8 milyar won (marj %31,5). 2026'nın ilk yarısında hasılat 92,5 milyar won: 59,8 milyarı eğitim yayıncılığı, 29,1 milyarı mağaza. İş mevsimliktir: ders kitabı teslim edilen 2. ve 4. çeyrek kârlı, 1. ve 3. çeyrek zararlıdır.
report.moat_text: Hendek dar. Kanıt: basına ve bir ortağın mektubuna göre ilkokul öğretmenlerinin %93'ünden fazlası i-Scream S'i kullanıyor; şirket 2022 müfredatının matematik, sosyal bilgiler ve fen kitaplarında %40-58 payla ilk sırada; okul mağazasının kendi alanındaki payı yaklaşık %94. Esas faaliyet marjı dört yıldır %30 dolayında. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı 2021-2025'te %45,5, %46,7, %39,6, %21,0 ve %22,5; son 12 ayda %30,3 (bu son rakam değerleme kazancını içerir). Zayıf yanı üç tane. Birincisi, ders kitabını devlet öder ve fiyatı Eğitim Bakanlığı belirler: 2026'da fiyatlar yayıncıların istediğinin ortalama %81,7'sinde kaldı, 100 binden fazla basılan kitaplarda pazarlıkla ortalama %4,9 daha indi. Bu, fiyatlama gücünün sınırlı olduğunu gösterir. İkincisi, ders kitabı işi yalnız 2022'den beri var; müfredat değişince seçim yeniden yapılır. Üçüncüsü, yapay zekâ ders kitabı beklentisi boşa çıktı: 4 Ağustos 2025'te yasa bu ürünü ders kitabı olmaktan çıkarıp 'eğitim materyali' yaptı, kullanımı okulun isteğine kaldı. Brüt marjın enflasyonun yüksek olduğu yıllardaki seyri: bakıldı, şirketin belgesi açılamadı.
report.mgmt: En büyük ortak Sigongtech %26,17; kurucu Park Ki-seok %17,75, oğulları Park Dae-min %9,35 ve Park Hyo-min %5,71. En büyük ortak ve bağlı kişiler toplam %60,92 (2025 sonu); küçük ortakların payı %26,12. Şirket 30 Ağustos 2024'te KOSDAQ'a girdi: 2,46 milyon yeni pay, pay başına 32.000 won, yaklaşık 78,7 milyar won. Beş yılda pay sayısı %10,4 arttı; nedeni halka arz. Kâr dağıtımı: 2026-2028 için şirketin tek başına net kârının %40'ı nakit temettü. 7 Ağustos 2026'da pay başına 1.083 won ara temettü (yaklaşık 13,8 milyar won) ve 5 milyar wonluk geri alım kararı alındı; alınan payların %70'i iptal edilecek. 2025'te pay başına 1.554 won dağıtıldı; bu ödemeler sermaye yedeğinden yapıldı. Kusurlar: Kasım 2025'te şirket kendi paylarına dönüşebilen tahvil çıkardı (bilançoda yaklaşık 11 milyar won); kasada borcun çok üstünde nakit ve finansal yatırım duruyor (Haziran 2026: nakit 64,1 milyar, kısa vadeli finansal varlıklar 14,2 milyar, uzun vadeli yatırımlar 52,3 milyar won) ve bu yatırımların değerlemesi kârı oynatıyor; ana sözleşmeye gıda takviyesi, kozmetik ve gıda işleri eklendi, yaşlı bakımına da giriliyor. Ocak 2026'da %1,81 paylı bir ortak, kullanılmayan nakdi açık mektupla eleştirdi. Şerefiye yok (Haziran 2026). Hisse bazlı ücret (opsiyon programı var), geri alımın fiyatı, ilişkili taraf işlemleri ve bilanço dışı yükümlülükler: bakıldı, şirketin belgesi (DART) açılamadığı için okunamadı.
report.latest: 14 Ağustos 2026: 2026'nın ilk yarısında hasılat 92,5 milyar won (+%18,5), esas faaliyet kârı 23,9 milyar won (+%64,5), net kâr 34,5 milyar won (+%197,4). Net kâr esas faaliyet kârını geçti: ikinci çeyrekte esas faaliyet kârı 32,3 milyar, net kâr 41,8 milyar won. Fark finansal gelirden geliyor; basına göre yarıyıl kârında finansal varlık değerleme kazancı var. Veri sitesine göre son 12 ayın nakit dışı değerleme kazancı 14,85 milyar won (2025'te 2,08 milyar). Son dört çeyreğin net kârı 72,05 milyar won; esas faaliyet kârı 71,1 milyar won. Özsermaye Haziran 2026 sonunda 239,1 milyar won. Üçüncü çeyrek sonuçları bu rapor yazılırken henüz okunamadı. Rakamlar basın haberlerinden ve veri sitelerinden; şirketin kendi belgesi açılamadı.
risks: Fiyat testi son 12 ayın 72,05 milyar wonluk kârına dayanıyor; bunun yaklaşık beşte biri (14,85 milyar won, vergi öncesi) finansal varlık değerleme kazancı. Bu kazanç nakit değildir ve piyasayla geri dönebilir. Hesap ayrıca yılda yaklaşık %9 reel büyüme varsayıyor; oysa yeni müfredatın son basamağı 2026'da devreye girdi.

Ders kitabı döngüsü: kâr 2022 müfredatının sınıf sınıf devreye girmesiyle büyüdü (2025'te 3-4. sınıflar, 2026'da 5-6. sınıflar). Yeni basamak kalmayınca büyüme durabilir; beş yıllık geçmiş tam bir döngüyü göstermez ve şu an döngünün üst yarısındayız.

Tek alıcı devlettir. Ders kitabının fiyatını ve onayını Eğitim Bakanlığı belirler; 2026'da fiyatlar yayıncıların istediğinin %81,7'sinde kaldı. Yapay zekâ ders kitabı 4 Ağustos 2025'te yasayla ders kitabı olmaktan çıkarıldı; bu ürüne yapılan yatırımın karşılığı belirsiz.
Kore'de öğrenci sayısı azalıyor; ilkokul ders kitabı ve okul mağazası satışları öğrenci ve sınıf sayısına bağlıdır.

Aile ve Sigongtech payların %60,92'sini elinde tutuyor. Şirket ana iş dışına açılıyor (gıda takviyesi, kozmetik, yaşlı bakımı) ve kendi paylarına dönüşebilen tahvil çıkardı; küçük ortak için sermaye tahsisi riski var.
Bu rapordaki rakamların hiçbiri şirketin kendi belgesinden doğrulanamadı: DART sayfaları otomatik okumaya kapalı. Değerleme kazancının tutarı tek bir veri sitesine dayanıyor.

en.one: Classroom platform for elementary teachers and textbook publisher. Narrow moat; a fifth of trailing profit is a valuation gain; growth depends on the textbook cycle.
en.business: i-Scream Media runs i-Scream S, the digital content platform Korean elementary teachers use in class, and has published elementary textbooks since 2022. It also has an online store selling teaching aids to schools (i-Scream Mall) and teacher training. In 2025 revenue was 195.9 billion won and operating profit 61.8 billion won (a 31.5% margin). In the first half of 2026 revenue was 92.5 billion won: 59.8 billion from education publishing and 29.1 billion from the store. The business is seasonal: the second and fourth quarters, when textbooks are delivered, are profitable; the first and third quarters make a loss.
en.moat_text: The moat is narrow. Evidence: according to press reports and a shareholder's letter, more than 93% of elementary teachers use i-Scream S; the company ranks first with a 40-58% share in math, social studies and science textbooks under the 2022 curriculum; the school store has about 94% of its niche. Operating margin has been around 30% for four years. Real return on equity was 45.5%, 46.7%, 39.6%, 21.0% and 22.5% in 2021-2025, and 30.3% in the trailing 12 months (the last figure includes the valuation gain). There are three weaknesses. First, the state pays for textbooks and the Ministry of Education sets the price: in 2026 prices were set at an average of 81.7% of what publishers asked, and titles with print runs above 100,000 were negotiated down a further 4.9% on average. That shows limited pricing power. Second, the textbook business has existed only since 2022; when the curriculum changes, schools choose again. Third, the hope for AI textbooks fell through: on 4 August 2025 a law reclassified them from textbooks to 'educational material', leaving use to each school. Gross margin in the high-inflation years: checked, the company's own document could not be opened.
en.mgmt: The largest shareholder is Sigongtech with 26.17%; founder Park Ki-seok holds 17.75% and his sons Park Dae-min 9.35% and Park Hyo-min 5.71%. The largest shareholder and related parties hold 60.92% in total (end of 2025); minority shareholders hold 26.12%. The company listed on KOSDAQ on 30 August 2024: 2.46 million new shares at 32,000 won each, about 78.7 billion won. The share count rose 10.4% over five years because of the listing. Payout: for 2026-2028, cash dividends of 40% of the company's standalone net profit. On 7 August 2026 it declared an interim dividend of 1,083 won per share (about 13.8 billion won) and a 5 billion won buyback; 70% of the shares bought will be cancelled. In 2025 it paid 1,554 won per share, funded from capital reserve. Flaws: in November 2025 the company issued a bond exchangeable into its own shares (about 11 billion won on the balance sheet); it holds cash and financial investments far above its debt (June 2026: cash 64.1 billion won, short-term financial assets 14.2 billion, long-term investments 52.3 billion), and the valuation of those investments moves profit; the articles were amended to add health supplements, cosmetics and food, and it is entering senior care. In January 2026 a shareholder with 1.81% criticised the idle cash in an open letter. There is no goodwill (June 2026). Share-based pay (an option plan exists), buyback prices, related-party transactions and off-balance-sheet liabilities: checked, but could not be read because the company's own filings (DART) could not be opened.
en.latest: 14 August 2026: in the first half of 2026 revenue was 92.5 billion won (+18.5%), operating profit 23.9 billion won (+64.5%) and net profit 34.5 billion won (+197.4%). Net profit exceeded operating profit: in the second quarter operating profit was 32.3 billion won and net profit 41.8 billion won. The difference comes from financial income; according to the press, half-year profit includes valuation gains on financial assets. A data site shows a non-cash valuation gain of 14.85 billion won for the trailing 12 months (2.08 billion in 2025). Net profit for the last four quarters is 72.05 billion won; operating profit is 71.1 billion won. Equity was 239.1 billion won at the end of June 2026. Third-quarter results could not be read when this report was written. Figures come from press reports and data sites; the company's own document could not be opened.
risks: The price test rests on trailing 12-month profit of 72.05 billion won; about a fifth of it (14.85 billion won, pre-tax) is a valuation gain on financial assets. That gain is not cash and can reverse with the market. The calculation also assumes real growth of about 9% a year, while the last step of the new curriculum came into use in 2026.

Textbook cycle: profit grew as the 2022 curriculum was phased in grade by grade (grades 3-4 in 2025, grades 5-6 in 2026). With no new step left, growth may stop; five years of history do not show a full cycle, and we are now in its upper half.

The state is the only buyer. The Ministry of Education sets textbook prices and approvals; in 2026 prices were set at 81.7% of what publishers asked. AI textbooks lost textbook status by law on 4 August 2025; the return on the investment made in that product is uncertain.
The number of students in Korea is falling; elementary textbook and school store sales depend on the number of students and classes.

The family and Sigongtech hold 60.92% of the shares. The company is moving beyond its core business (health supplements, cosmetics, senior care) and has issued a bond exchangeable into its own shares; this is a capital allocation risk for minority shareholders.
None of the figures in this report could be verified in the company's own documents: DART pages are closed to automated reading. The amount of the valuation gain rests on a single data site.

growth_facts.note_en: The rise in net profit overstates the growth of the business: first-half profit includes a valuation gain on financial assets. Over the same period operating profit rose 64.5% and revenue 18.5%. The company published no adjusted profit and no 2026 profit guidance. Because the judgment only lowers the rate, this does not change the calculation.

All facts are from press (Money Today / Etoday 19 Aug 2026, reporting the company's 14 Aug 2026 half-year filing) and data sites, so primary:false everywhere. H1 2025 net profit 11.6 billion = 34.5 / 2.974 and matches etfshopping quarters (-7.4 + 19.0). Quarter: Q2 2026 41.8 vs Q2 2025 19.0 billion (etfshopping earnings table; alphasquare gives 418.1억 for Q2 2026). EPS changes not published in anything I read; share count roughly flat year on year (IPO was Aug 2024), so net profit is a fair proxy. Q3 2026 (due around 14 Nov 2026) was not available in any source on 14 Nov 2026; Q3 is a seasonal loss quarter (Q3 2025: -4.05 billion). Both measures are far above the formula rate (g 9.27), so no reduction results; operating profit H1 +64.5%. One could argue `exclude` for securities valuation, but it would not change the outcome. Structural point for the main session: the 2022-curriculum rollout to grades 5-6 completes in 2026, so the past growth trend has a visible end, but the company has given no figure for 2027, so nothing was entered under departed/guidance (no estimating). No permanent cause: the AI-textbook downgrade (law of 4 Aug 2025) hit a new product, not the existing textbook profit. Dividend: source has no yield. Declared so far for 2026: interim 1,083 won (board decision 7 Aug 2026, about 13.8 billion won, 39.98% of half-year profit); policy is 40% of standalone net profit for 2026-2028. 2025 calendar payments were 368 (record 30 Jun 2025) + 1,186 (record 30 Sep 2025) = 1,554 won, funded from capital reserve (non-taxable reduction dividends), plus 738 for year-end 2024. I entered only the 1,083 interim as the conservative declared figure; the main session may prefer a different basis.

Quarterly net profit (억 won): Q3 2025 -40.5, Q4 2025 416.3, Q1 2026 -73.4, Q2 2026 418.1 (alphasquare; etfshopping gives -41, 416, -73, 418 with announcement dates 14 Nov 2025, 19 Mar 2026, 15 May 2026, 14 Aug 2026) = 720.5억 = 72,050 million; stockanalysis TTM net income 72,045 million, EPS 5,577.73. Source check: market cap 213,200 / P/E 3.03 = 70,363 million, 2.3% BELOW my figure, so the source does not overstate. Operating profit by quarter (억): -80.7, 553.0, -84.3, 323.3 = 711.3; TTM operating profit 71,131 million (stockanalysis). So TTM net profit (720.5) exceeds TTM operating profit (711.3) before tax: in FY2025 net was 491.7 on operating 617.6 (net/operating 0.80). stockanalysis pretax margin: TTM 43.83% x 210,354 = about 92,200 million pretax vs operating 71,131, i.e. about 21,100 million of net non-operating income in the 12 months; FY2025 31.47% x 195,911 = about 61,650 pretax vs operating 61,763, i.e. about zero. valueline: finance income TTM 244억 (FY2025 59억); cash-flow adjustment line 금융자산평가이익 TTM Jun 2026 148.5억 vs FY2025 20.8억, Mar 2026 TTM 25.0억: so nearly all of the gain arose in Q2 2026. Newsworker (8 Sep 2026) confirms in words that half-year profit includes financial asset valuation gains and that net profit tripled on 'core growth and higher financial income'; it gives no amount. I entered the 148.5억 valuation gain only (frac = 14,850 / 72,050 = 0.2061, pre-tax, no tax deducted). Alternatives the main session may consider: (a) with an effective rate derived from the data site (TTM 1 - 72,045/92,200 = 21.9%; FY2025 20.2%) the after-tax frac would be 0.161; (b) the whole excess non-operating income of about 21,100 million pre-tax would be frac 0.29, but the remainder is interest and other income on the cash and financial assets, which is recurring, so I did not count it. About 2 billion won a year of valuation gain looked recurring in 2025; I did not net it off. Which asset produced the gain is unknown (FVPL-type investments on the valueline balance sheet: 70.9 billion at Dec 2025, 49.4 billion at Jun 2026; equity-method investments rose by about 7.7 billion). Simply Wall St (27 Nov 2025) said unusual items REDUCED profit by 9.2 billion won in the year to Sep 2025: non-operating items swing both ways here. No company EPS guidance for 2026 (the only company forecast seen was for 2025: revenue 208 billion, operating profit 66 billion, fair disclosure of 3 Jul 2025; actual 195.9 and 61.8, i.e. the company missed its own forecast by about 6%). Equity 239,140 million at 30 Jun 2026 (valueline), market cap / equity = 0.89, matching the dataset P/B. Shares issued 13,365,433 (alphasquare); treasury shares about 4.5% (butler.works).
